<<MENDING OF FISHING NETS, BRIEFLY>>

THE NEIGHBORHOOD IS WORKING TO MEND FISHING NETS. LOCAL FARMERS AND RESIDENTS ARE COLLECTING NETS AND REPAIRING THEM. THE EFFORT IS TO PREVENT FISHING DAMAGE AND HELP FISH RETURN TO THE WATER. EVERYONE IS CONTRIBUTING TO A MORE SUSTAINABLE FISHING LIFESTYLE. THIS IS A COMMUNITY EFFORT TO PRESERVE OUR WATERWAYS.
